items.title: Haryana e-procurement audit finds bid rigging signs and missing system controls
items.dek: An audit of Haryana's e-procurement system records that multiple bids came from the same computers and that key financial rules were bypassed, while the system's own records do not explain why.

items.title: Jharkhand wage delays and incomplete works shadow MGNREGS record
items.dek: An audit of MGNREGS in Jharkhand shows wage arrears of over 321 crore rupees and a quarter of planned works never started, while the official record cannot confirm what workers actually received.
items.theme: Wage arrears and incomplete works in Jharkhand's MGNREGS

items.title: Nagaland's fiscal deficit exceeded legal targets for the third straight year, audit finds
items.dek: The state's own revenue grew, but grants from the Centre fell, and spending on committed costs left little room for capital investment, according to the latest audit of state finances.
items.theme: Fiscal discipline and public spending in Nagaland

items.title: Green India Mission funding shortfall leaves afforestation targets unmet
items.dek: The national audit finds that the Green India Mission received less than half of its planned budget over ten years, and the record does not show how the gap affected the people who depend on forests.
items.theme: Funding shortfall in a national afforestation programme

items.title: Veterinary care in West Bengal faces shortages that the state's own audit record now documents
items.dek: An audit of 12 West Bengal departments finds animal health centres without essential equipment, medicines, and waste disposal, leaving farmers and livestock owners without assured treatment.
